description: Analyze nutrient trends over time by quarter. Essential for detecting the potassium cliff in Block C since mid-2022.

configuration.query: FROM vineyard-npk | WHERE block_id == ?block_id | STATS avg_k = AVG(soil_potassium_mgkg), avg_n = AVG(soil_nitrogen_mgkg), avg_ph = AVG(ph) BY BUCKET(timestamp, 3 months) | SORT `BUCKET(timestamp, 3 months)` ASC
